name: RE:D Cherish! SS Rouge no One Operation
original_name: RE:D Cherish! SS ルージュのワンオペレーション
source:
With the chaos involving Caroline finally settled, Rouge had reconciled with her mother, Belladonna.
Rouge was now living a blissful, lovey-dovey life with Yukimitsu.
But even though they’d made up, Rouge and Belladonna still couldn’t quite bridge the gap between them.
Seeing this, Yukimitsu decided to step in and help mend their relationship—

※This story takes place just before the epilogue of the main story RE:D Cherish! (Rouge’s route), a little before the birth of their child.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1251011]getchu[/url]]
